abstract: We report the novel observation that a biphasic, parieto-visceral (PYS/VYS) yolk sac carcinoma can develop from the isolated epiblast of the pre-primitive streak rat embryo in a prolonged cultivation in vivo as a renal isograft. Late 7-day rat egg cylinders were dissected free of the ectoplacental cone and the Reichert's membrane. The middle segment of the cylinder, in which the embryonic and the extraembryonic cell layers partly overlap, were also removed. From the rest of the cylinder the 4 cell layers were isolated and transplanted separately under the kidney capsule of isogenic adult males. After 4 weeks the hypoblast was resorbed, the extraembryonic ectoderm gave rise to hemorrhagic cysts and trophoblastic giant cells, the extraembryonic (visceral yolk sac) endoderm formed benign cystic PYS/VYS tumors, and the epiblast developed into a benign teratoma. After prolonged (7-30 weeks) development of these teratomas as isografts, a malignant yolk sac carcinoma (YSC) developed in 45% of them. It destroyed the teratoma and the recipient's kidney, metastasized to peritoneum and other sites, and caused abundant ascites containing clustered tumor cells. The primary tumor was retransplantable subcutaneously as well as intraperitoneally, and displayed the characteristics of the mixed or biphasic PVYS carcinoma, with a progressive loss of the VYS component with time. Several data are apparently in favor of its origin by transdifferentiation rather than from undifferentiated cells.
abstract_ja: 我々は、ラット原始線条期前胚の上胚盤葉を単離し、長期の生体内培養を経て腎同系移植片として生じた、二相性の壁側・臓側(PYS/VYS)卵黄嚢癌を報告する。7日齢の後期ラット卵筒を、胎盤外錐(ectoplacental cone)とライヘルト膜から切り離した。胚体層と胚外細胞層が部分的に重なる卵筒の中央部分も除去した。残りの卵筒から4つの細胞層を単離し、それぞれ別々に同系成熟雄の腎被膜下へ移植した。4週間後、下胚葉は吸収され、胚外外胚葉は出血性嚢胞と栄養膜巨細胞を生じた。胚外内胚葉(臓側卵黄嚢内胚葉)は良性の嚢胞性PYS/VYS腫瘍を形成し、上胚盤葉は良性奇形腫へ発達した。これらの奇形腫を同系移植片として7～30週間にわたり長期発育させた後、その45%で悪性の卵黄嚢癌(YSC)が発生した。YSCは奇形腫と宿主の腎臓を破壊し、腹膜やその他の部位へ転移し、腫瘍細胞の集塊を含む大量の腹水を引き起こした。原発腫瘍は皮下および腹腔内への再移植が可能で、混合型または二相性のPVYS癌の特徴を示し、時間とともに VYS成分が進行的に消失した。いくつかのデータは、未分化細胞からではなく分化転換によって起源したことを支持している。
